heading: FAQ’s on Media & Entertainment App Development Solutions

items.question: Can the app stream live content?
items.answer: Yes. Live streaming can be added alongside on-demand content.

items.question: Does it support offline downloads?
items.answer: Yes. Downloads for offline viewing are available.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A branded launch typically takes 6–8 weeks, depending on customisation.

items.question: Can I offer subscriptions?
items.answer: Yes. Subscription plans and pay-per-view are supported.

items.question: Is content protected?
items.answer: DRM and secure streaming options can be included.

items.question: How much does a streaming app cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on features and infrastructure. Share your requirements for an estimate.
